_doc: Shared spec for table_shape_equivalence (P4.D248, v4 e5c6bd0c0 bug 176). shapeCases run over EVERY real structural schema; linksTargets drive v4's own test-shaped LinksRepository through both dedicated targets; plants run over v4's own generateDDL-created mount-index + LLM-logs substrate and are replayed by v5's real boot-pass pieces. A plant with divergence=true is a RECORDED divergence pinned both ways by the Rust side (v4's out and v5's out asserted separately).

plants.name: link-relativepath
plants.why: dogfood #134: the file-links NOCASE repair SELECTs relativePath, so the ENSURE fails first on both sides (v4's API.md example string is not what v4 emits here)
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_file_links RENAME COLUMN relativePath TO relativePath_x

plants.name: folder-name
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_folders RENAME COLUMN name TO name_x

plants.name: point-name
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points RENAME COLUMN name TO name_x

plants.name: link-group-index
mount: DROP INDEX idx_doc_mount_file_links_linkGroupId
CREATE TABLE idx_doc_mount_file_links_linkGroupId (x TEXT)

plants.name: chunk-heading
plants.why: a column no ensure step names: the SHAPE form on both sides
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_chunks RENAME COLUMN headingContext TO headingContext_x

plants.name: link-description
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_file_links RENAME COLUMN description TO description_x

plants.name: two-tables
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_chunks RENAME COLUMN headingContext TO headingContext_x
ALTER TABLE doc_mount_file_links RENAME COLUMN description TO description_x

plants.name: chunk-view
plants.why: MEASURED at e5c6bd0c0 (the survey's 'is a view on both sides' refuted): SQLite rejects CREATE INDEX on a view BEFORE its IF NOT EXISTS name check, so v4's ensure fails 'views may not be indexed' even with every index kept (the ensure form); v5 never ensures doc_mount_chunks and reads the view (the shape form)
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_chunks RENAME TO doc_mount_chunks_x
CREATE VIEW doc_mount_chunks AS SELECT * FROM doc_mount_chunks_x

plants.name: llm-column
llm: ALTER TABLE llm_logs RENAME COLUMN provider TO provider_x

plants.name: files-dropped
plants.why: v4's ensure CREATES an absent table and reports it sound; v5 creates it from v4's own DDL dump at boot (R3 reversed by the human's ruling, 2026-10-03), so both report nothing
mount: DROP TABLE doc_mount_files

plants.name: points-pre-alter
plants.why: v4's doc_mount_points ensure (onTableEnsured) ADDs totalSizeBytes back with its INFO line and reports the table sound; v5 runs the same four guarded ALTERs as a lazy ensure before the name-collision repair (P4.150 — was a pinned divergence)
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN totalSizeBytes

plants.name: points-pre-alter-conversion-status
plants.why: the second of v4's four self-heals
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN conversionStatus

plants.name: points-pre-alter-conversion-error
plants.why: the third of v4's four self-heals (the one nullable column)
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN conversionError

plants.name: points-pre-alter-store-type
plants.why: the fourth of v4's four self-heals
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN storeType

plants.name: points-pre-alter-all-four
plants.why: all four dropped (in a different order): v4's four INFO lines in ITS order — totalSizeBytes, conversionStatus, conversionError, storeType
mount: ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN storeType
ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN conversionError
ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN totalSizeBytes
ALTER TABLE doc_mount_points DROP COLUMN conversionStatus

plants.name: chunk-view-index-gone
plants.why: with the createdAt index dropped first, v4's ensure fails 'views may not be indexed' (the ensure form); v5 never ensures doc_mount_chunks and reads the view (the shape form)
mount: DROP INDEX idx_doc_mount_chunks_createdAt
ALTER TABLE doc_mount_chunks RENAME TO doc_mount_chunks_x
CREATE VIEW doc_mount_chunks AS SELECT * FROM doc_mount_chunks_x
